item.title: Adam Scott's Criminally Overlooked 2026 Thriller Is Finally on Streaming
item.description: You know it's been a good year for horror movies when a genuine hit still slips through the cracks. We spent the summer on discourse over Obsession, The Backrooms , Zach Cregger's Resident Evil , and The End of Oak Street , all of which pulled in nine-digit takes at the box office. Before that, 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple was a critical if not a commercial success. Usually horror fans have to sort through indies for their genre fix, but this year has been a movable feast.

item.title: 63 Years Later, the Stellar Action Comic Strip Most America Never Heard of Deserves Another Shot
item.description: This goes double for newspaper comics, which are often viewed as disposable in ways that graphic novels aren't. Surprisingly few of them ever pick up an international audience. Exceptions include Andy Capp and Fred Basset , British strips that have substantially outlived their original creators. They do not include the British Dennis the Menace , which debuted in Beano in 1951, five days after Hank Ketcham started a strip by the same name in America.

item.title: New Steam Game is Basically Kiki’s Delivery Service in Video Game Form
item.description: Sharing food with others begets a certain type of magic. That goes double for baked goods and desserts. In The Witch’s Bakery , that magic is literal. It’s a charming, cozy, and heartfelt adventure that goes heavy on the Studio Ghibli vibes.

item.title: CBS's Definitive '80s Action Thriller Series Is Officially Free to Watch on Streaming
item.description: Premiering on CBS in 1984, Airwolf starred Jan-Michael Vincent as Hawke, a brooding Vietnam veteran and test pilot who takes possession of a top-secret military helicopter. Alongside his friend and mentor Dominic Santini (Ernest Borgnine), Hawke flies dangerous missions for a shadowy intelligence organization while they search for his brother, who disappeared during the Vietnam War. It was part Cold War espionage thriller, part high-tech fantasy, and an awful lot of things exploding in the sky.

item.title: 36 Years Later, Robert De Niro's Greatest Gangster Movie Quote Is Still One of a Kind
item.description: Few actors have done more to shape the modern cinematic gangster than Robert De Niro . Across decades of mob dramas, he's played men who command respect through intimidation, calculation, and a religious devotion to the rules of their world. From The Godfather to The Irishman , De Niro's proven himself one of the most popular leading men to handle some of the worst gangsters on the silver screen, including Al Capone, Vito Corleone, Frank Costello , David “Noodles” Aaronson, James Burke, and plenty more.

item.title: 8 Mass Effect Replay Ideas That Make the Trilogy Feel Brand-New
item.description: Every replay of the Mass Effect games tends to start with a promise: this time, you’ll do things differently. Then Shepard makes the same speech, you bring the same squad, and you’re right back where you started. BioWare’s Mass Effect Legendary Edition , the remastered trilogy released in May 2021, makes starting over easy. But the best replay value is in changing the rules. Swap the class you always play, tank a choice on purpose, or finish the whole thing with one gun. These eight runs each come with their own mission parameters. And this time, maybe you’ll really do things differently.

item.title: Drunken Goddess Reflux Devs Cancel Steam Next Fest Demo Over AI Clone Concerns
item.description: Drunken Goddess Reflux is an upcoming indie game where players must survive a night of drinking with a beautiful anime demon, Russian Roulette-style. It's certainly a unique concept, and the game has already amassed over 25,000 wishlists on Steam . While the game was supposed to have a demo during Steam Next Fest, the developers decided to cancel the demo's release at the last minute so the game wouldn't instigate a wave of generative AI-developed clones.

item.title: Street Fighter Fails To Match Resident Evil's Opening Weekend Box Office Success
item.description: Looking at the fall slate of blockbuster films, I was most interested in finding out whether Resident Evil or Street Fighter would have the bigger opening weekend. We now have our answer: Street Fighter grossed about half of what Resident Evil did in its first weekend .

item.title: 13 Years Ago, 'The Legend of Korra' Finally Answered the Biggest Avatar Mystery
item.description: Then, at a dire point midway through Legend of Korra season 2 when the South Pole spirit portal was opened, plunging the water tribes into civil war, Korra is swallowed by a massive dark spirit while at sea. She loses her memory. So much of each Avatar’s journey has been about reconnecting with their past selves, using their memories, shared knowledge, and skills accumulated over thousands of years. But perhaps for the first time ever, Korra is the only one who must go all the way back to the very beginning.

item.title: Epic Games CEO Believes A 'Golden Age Of Gaming' Is Imminent Because of AI
item.description: Tim Sweeney, the CEO of Fortnite and Unreal Engine devleoper Epic Games, has repeatedly supported the use of AI in video game development. His stance has been controversial, considering that many gamers and developers are anti-AI . Nevertheless, he continues to defend it, arguing that AI coding has become significantly better in the past year and will usher in a "golden age of gaming."
